artworks.title: Two Women before a Mirror
artworks.description: The image is a line drawing portraying two individuals in a scene. Both figures are illustrated from head to toe. The person on the left is in a side-facing position, while the person on the right is turned slightly away and to the side. The person on the left has a high bun and is wearing a hat with decorations. The other person has wavy hair that falls to just above the shoulders. Both individuals are wearing floor-length garments, with the person on the right also having a shoulder cape. In the background, there is a wall with a mounted head and an outline of a window or frame above a possible mantle or ledge.

artworks.title: Two Women before a Mirror
artworks.description: The image shows two individuals in a room. One person is standing in profile facing left, wearing a light-colored hat with decorations, a cloak, and has light-colored hair. The second individual is turned slightly away, with their back mostly towards the viewer, wearing a long blue garment with vertical stripes, an ornate white collar, and short orange hair. Both individuals are depicted from the upper half of their bodies. The background consists of sketched yellow vertical lines, a dresser with a mirror reflecting part of their image, and a faintly drawn interior space with furniture and objects.

artworks.title: Man and Woman
artworks.description: The image is an ink drawing showing a full-body portrait of a standing woman and a partial view of a person lying in bed. The woman stands beside the bed, leaning slightly towards the person in bed with a faint smile. She is wearing a loose gown, slippers, and holding an object. The person in bed is only partially visible, with their head on a pillow, likely sleeping. The background is minimal, with outlines hinting at curtains or a plain wall, and a simplistic bed. The scene is drawn in a loose, sketchy style, with a largely blank background.

artworks.title: Snobism
artworks.description: The image depicts multiple figures in a social setting. In the foreground, a man and a woman are seated at a table. The man, viewed from behind, is showing something to the woman. They are both wearing formal attire. On the table are a bottle and glass. Behind them is an intricately patterned railing or wall decoration. In the background to the right are three figures, one wearing a large coat and top hat, while the others appear to be in uniform or formal wear. The sketch has a minimalist black and white aesthetic.

artworks.title: The Marco Brothers
artworks.description: This is an image showing a small figure confronting a large, bent-over figure. The large figure appears muscular, leaning forward with flexed arms and a pronounced torso. The smaller figure, wearing dark pants and a light shirt, faces the giant. The giant's exaggerated, cartoon-like features and the smaller figure's expressive posture suggest a sense of dynamism. Bold, defined lines and a plain background emphasize the interaction between the two figures with a minimalist approach.

artworks.title: The Marco Brothers
artworks.description: The image depicts flowing, curved lines forming two figures engaged in an abstract interaction or struggle. One figure is smaller with distinct lines for the torso and limbs, while the larger figure has bold, curved outlines creating an exaggerated form. A round object above them is depicted with simple lines.

artworks.title: Wisdom (Sagesse)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on China paper
artworks.description: The image showcases three figures. The left figure is a bald man in a suit with a bow tie. The figure in the middle has curly hair tied up and wears an elegant dress. The third figure has dark, curly hair. A tall, ornate lamp is on the right. The background has text saying "sagesse." The figures do not have any accessories. The style of the art is sketch-like.

artworks.title: The Man of Sorrows and Mater Dolorosa
artworks.medium: woodcut with letterpress text, highlighted with red ink, on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an engraving with two figures depicted from the waist up to the head. On the left is a bearded man with a crown of thorns, appearing topless with visible ribs and blood trickling down from his head and chest. On the right is a woman cloaked in robes with a hood over her head, holding a rod in her right hand which she points towards the man. The background features decorative foliage motifs and various objects hanging from hooks. There is an inset panel with Latin text below the figures, bordered by intricate patterns throughout the design.

artworks.title: Henri Daumier (Honore Daumier)
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed drawing of the head of an elderly man. The man is depicted slightly turned to the side, facing towards the right of the viewer. He has prominent brows, slightly closed eyes, a large nose, and full lips. His light-colored hair appears thinning with longer strands falling over his ears and the top of his head. The drawing is monochromatic, accentuating the lines and shadows on the man's face and head. No clothing, jewelry, or objects are shown, and there are no background elements. The head is surrounded by a dark shading, contrasting with the lighter tones used for the face.

artworks.title: La Manifestation (The Demonstration)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a chaotic scene on a street. The scene is depicted with bold black lines on a plain background. A group of individuals are shown running and falling in different directions. The style is simplified and graphic, focusing on the contrast between light and dark. The composition directs the eye through a crowd, where hats and scarves are swirling. In the foreground, a top hat and umbrella have been dropped. The piece resembles the expressive graphic style associated with early 20th-century European printmaking.

artworks.title: Le Poker (Poker)
artworks.description: The image shows five individuals seated around a rectangular table. Each person is depicted from the waist up in a silhouette style. One person is at each side of the table and one at the far end facing the viewer. The central figure facing the viewer has distinct facial features, including a beard and short hair. The other individuals have varying facial features such as a bald head with round glasses, a full beard, and clean-shaven faces. They are wearing formal attire, including suits and dress shirts. In the center of the table, there is a candelabrum with five lit candles. The table is scattered with poker chips. The background is solid black, emphasizing the game and the players.

artworks.title: Frontispiece from "Paris Intense"
artworks.description: This is a drawing of various figures standing in a row under a sign that reads "PARIS INTENSE". The artwork features a variety of characters stylized with bold outlines and minimal shading, positioned in front of a backdrop that resembles cobblestone pavement. Each character is distinct in appearance, from a rotund figure wearing a top hat to others dressed in more casual attire. The expressions and postures of the figures convey a sense of caricature, capturing a diverse and bustling atmosphere typical of urban life.

artworks.title: Album Cover for "Paris Intense"
artworks.description: The image shows a line of individuals with different appearances. The first person is wearing a coat and a top hat while holding a cane. Next to them is a woman wearing a dark cloak with feathers on her hat. Beside her is a child in dark clothing and a hat with a pom-pom, holding hands with a man in a casual shirt and a tilted hat. Following them are two women smiling and embracing each other. The last individual is wearing a tailed coat, a hat, and a bow tie. In the background, there is a textured wall with signs that say "PARIS INTENSE" and "par F. Vallotton," and a person in shadows on the left side.

artworks.title: Les Chanteurs (The Singers)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a bustling street scene with people gathered and interacting. The image is illustrated in a style reminiscent of late 19th-century French prints, with bold outlines and flat areas of color. The focus appears to be on a group of individuals at the center who are seemingly engaged in singing or reading aloud, as suggested by the papers some are holding. These figures are surrounded by an audience dressed in period attire, creating a vibrant sense of movement and social interaction. The cobbled street and the dynamic poses of the figures suggest a lively atmosphere. The artwork is framed with a thick black outline.

artworks.title: Au Violon (Off to the Jug)
artworks.description: The image is a painting of a street scene with various figures engaging in different activities in front of a row of shops. The scene includes a manhole with a man peering out, scattered bricks around him. Pedestrians are casually standing, conversing or observing. The shop signs read "MODES" and "EPICER." The palette consists of bold, contrasting tones, resembling a woodcut or linocut effect, capturing form and texture. This art style is reminiscent of Félix Vallotton.

artworks.title: Deuxieme Bureau (Box Office)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of individuals behind a wooden barrier with some leaning over or standing closely together. They are dressed in formal attire with hats and coats. There are posters behind them. A guard is standing in front of the fence, dressed in uniform, with his hands clasped together.

artworks.title: Le Monôme (Parading through the Streets in Single File)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a crowd of people depicted in a linear style. The image shows a densely packed group of individuals, all wearing formal attire including top hats and coats. The scene captures the dynamic movement of a procession or gathering. The figures are mainly depicted from the waist up and are rendered in a simplified and stylized manner. The drawing uses a limited color palette, primarily black ink on a cream or light tan background.

artworks.title: L'Averse (The Shower)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rainy street scene. The image depicts a bustling urban environment where horse-drawn carriages and pedestrians dominate the streets. The illustration is rendered in strong black and white contrast, capturing the essence of an active city street under the pouring rain. The figures, using umbrellas, seem to be struggling against the rain and wind. In the background, outlines of buildings and trees provide a sense of depth, while the rain is illustrated with diagonal lines suggesting its direction. This detailed depiction gives the viewer a vivid sense of the weather's impact on city life, emphasizing the resilience and motion of the scene.

artworks.title: L'Accident (The Accident)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street accident involving a horse-drawn carriage. The scene shows a horse rearing up on its hind legs, causing chaos. Several individuals are trying to control the situation, with one person managing the horse and another holding onto the side of the carriage. The drawing is done in a dramatic, illustrative style with bold black lines against a brownish background. A small crowd of onlookers watches from the side. The background is minimal, focusing on the struggle between man and beast in the center of the composition.

artworks.title: Folding the Linen (Le pliage du linge)
artworks.description: The image shows three people standing and holding a large piece of fabric together. The individuals are seen from head to about mid-calf, with their faces not clearly defined. One person has long hair and another has a bun hairstyle. They are dressed in modest, long flowing dresses or skirts. The background consists of a pattern resembling foliage or a textured wall. There are no visible jewelry or objects apart from the fabric they are holding. The setting appears to be indoors or in a space near a garden, but it is hard to determine due to the detailed background pattern.

artworks.title: Saint Matthew
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in a spacious architectural setting. The faint, sketch-like lines form a scene where multiple figures are engaged in various activities beneath what appears to be a high ceiling with arches. There are soft, free-flowing pencil or ink lines that suggest movement and a sense of casual bustling or interaction among the figures. The architectural backdrop is suggested by simple lines indicating arches, columns, and possibly windows, creating a sense of depth and perspective. The figures are non-detailed, emphasizing form and posture over facial features. The overall composition feels lively and captures a moment of dynamic interaction in a public or civic space.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Philip
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures engaged in an activity around a structure with a flag. The drawing depicts several figures gathered around a central point, where a structure resembling a tall frame is present. Some figures appear to be climbing or perched on top of the structure, while others are gathered below. An elongated shape, possibly a flag or banner, extends skyward. The lines are delicate and sparse, suggesting motion and interaction among the figures, rendered in a minimalistic and fluid style.

artworks.title: The Cavalry Combat
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. The sketch depicts a chaotic and dynamic scene with several horses and figures engaged in a skirmish or battle. Horses are rearing and figures are seen in various action poses, suggesting movement and turmoil. The background is faintly marked with lines that could represent movement or possibly plumes of dust and smoke. The composition is light, with minimal detailing, giving a sense of fluidity and speed, emphasizing the action taking place.
